The UDP-9 is a straight blowback operating AR-9 pistol caliber carbine. It features a number of AR-15 style components but shots 9mm. Accepts any 9mm GLOCK magazine while featuring last round bolt hold open.
 %c[ui_gray_2]ATTACHMENTS:
 %c[d_purple] • %c[ui_gray_2] Sights: NATO 
 %c[d_purple] • %c[ui_gray_2] Silencer: GemTech Suppressor
